title: Chiseled Copper Golem (Extension for "Original Copper")
description: Copper Golem now lives in Chiseled Copper Block!
body:
Now Copper Golem lives in the Chiseled Copper Blocks!

This resource pack changes the Chiseled Copper in all of its stages to represent the Copper Golem mob as other chiseled blocks also represent mobs.

**Note: This resource pack is an extension for my other resource pack _Original Copper_ (Available only on Planet Minecraft for the moment)**

For the version with the default Minecraft colors of this pack check [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/chiseled-copper-golem).
